import importlib.util,json,hashlib
from jsonschema import Draft202012Validator
P=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
path=P/'repository/experiments/EXP-NISTSEED-6886da/aa-admission/test_aa_fixture_producer.py'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('aa_schema_tests',path);m=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(m)
t=m.Tests('runTest');t.setUp()
try:
 result=t.call('schema-live-fixture')
 schema=json.loads((path.parent/'aa_fixture_schema.json').read_text())
 Draft202012Validator.check_schema(schema)
 errors=sorted([{'path':list(e.absolute_path),'message':e.message} for e in Draft202012Validator(schema).iter_errors(result)],key=lambda x:str(x['path']))
finally:t.tearDown()
receipt={'schema_sha256':hashlib.sha256((path.parent/'aa_fixture_schema.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'errors':errors,'status':'PASS' if not errors else 'FAIL','named_orders_executed':0,'legacy_program_executed':False,'vm_calls':0}
(P/'aa-schema-validation-v2.json').write_text(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2)+'\n');print(json.dumps(receipt,indent=2))
raise SystemExit(0 if not errors else 1)
